target: constraints/constraints.sdc (I/O section, lines with set_input_delay / set_output_delay)
what: No set_driving_cell or set_input_transition on the inputs and no set_load on count[*]. Input slew and output load default to ideal (zero), so I/O path delays and output timing are slightly optimistic.
evidence: The SDC contains only create_clock, set_clock_uncertainty, set_max_fanout, set_input_delay and set_output_delay. REQ-011 needs setup and hold WNS >= 0 at the configured corners, and the margin there depends on realistic boundary conditions.
suggested_action: Add a set_driving_cell (for example sky130_fd_sc_hd__buf_2 or inv_2) on the inputs and a set_load on count[*] taken from the PnR config. Record the values as DEFAULT for G1 review. Do not use these additions to loosen anything else.
